people-yearbyyear.json.note: gen-org's person request (scripts/data/gen-org.mjs). Two players, one per stat group.

person-season.json.note: The prospect card's request (src/lib/model/card.js), pinned to 2026 so a finished season's content cannot change.

person-season-multilevel.json.note: The prospect card's request for 2025: one split per level plus a Minors total.

roster-season-2025-biloxi.json.note: gen-archive's roster request (scripts/data/gen-archive.mjs). Trimmed to six players.

people-mlb-yearbyyear.json.note: gen-mlb's person request (scripts/data/gen-mlb.mjs). Cameron and Gallardo, trimmed to a few seasons; Cameron's 2011 has a traded-player total split with no team and numTeams 2. Made has no MLB rows and no stats block.

people-milb-careers.json.note: gen-careers' person request (scripts/data/gen-careers.mjs). Sheets and Gagne, bio fields trimmed. Sheets has no-team totals (sportId 21) and clubs outside the Brewers system; Gagne has no totals.

standings-2019-pioneer.json.note: The standings request (scripts/data/lib/standings.mjs) for the Pioneer League, 2019. Two teams kept, and each team's nested records block dropped. Includes Rocky Mountain Vibes (551), 32-43, division rank 3. Strings: winningPercentage, divisionRank.

standings-2006-arizona.json.note: The same request for the Arizona League, 2006. AZL Brewers (406) only. This league had no divisions: the team record has no divisionRank, and the record has no division.

gamelog-hitter-2026.json.note: The per-player game log (#35), for a hitter. Eduardo Garcia, trimmed to five rows: his first game, a doubleheader on 2026-06-04 (same date, two gamePks, game 2 has plateAppearances 0), his last Biloxi game and his first Nashville game. Without leagueListId=milb_all it returns no rows.

gamelog-starter-2026.json.note: The per-player game log (#35), for a starter. Colton Gordon, trimmed to three rows: a start for Sugar Land (an Astros club, before he joined the system), his one relief outing, and his first Nashville start. inningsPitched is a string.

gamelog-reliever-2026.json.note: The per-player game log (#35), for a reliever at Nashville. Trimmed to three rows, all gamesStarted 0.

people-gamelog-2026.json.note: The batched game log that gen-gamelog (#35) will read: one stats block per group the player has. Blake Burke (hitting) and Colton Gordon (pitching), bio fields and rows trimmed to two per block.

people-fielding-yearbyyear.json.note: gen-org's person request with fielding added (#40). Burke: a 2026 no-team 1B total (sportId 21), his Biloxi 1B row and a DH row (innings 0.0, chances 0, fielding .000). Ragsdale: Biloxi LF with 10 innings and 0 chances (also .000), Biloxi CF, Springfield CF (a Cardinals club) and the no-team Double-A CF total. Gordon: a Nashville P row. One hitting or pitching row each.

splits-hitter-2026.json.note: The per-player situational splits (#41). Blake Burke at Double-A (sportId 12): all seven sitCodes, one Biloxi row each. Without sportId, the splits merge every level.

people-splits-hitting-2026.json.note: The batched splits request (#41), one per level. Burke: vl and vr at Biloxi. Ragsdale played for Biloxi and Springfield at Double-A: vl for each club plus a no-team vl total.

people-splits-pitching-2026.json.note: The batched splits request for pitchers (#41 covers both sides): opponent lines. The reliever 657649 at Nashville: risp. Gordon at Triple-A: vl for Sugar Land (an Astros club), Nashville and the no-team total.
